deadline.value: Priority Fall application deadline is April 1, 2027 (final deadline June 15 if space is available; Spring priority October 1, final November 1).
deadline.quote: Deadlines: April 1 (priority deadline) or June 15 (final deadline, if space available) for fall, October 1 (priority deadline) or November 1 (final deadline, if space available) for spring

gre_general.value: GRE scores are recommended for Chemistry PhD admission.
gre_general.quote: Applicants must meet general graduate admission requirements in addition to the following program-specific requirements: | Test Scores: GRE recommended

gre_subject.value: ETS discontinued the Chemistry GRE Subject Test; only the GRE General Test is recommended.

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Department of Chemistry does not state whether a faculty advisor must be contacted before applying.

funding.value: Graduate teaching and research assistantships are assigned by the department ($25,865 stipend + 100% tuition waiver for a 1.0 FTE TA/RA in AY 2026-27).
funding.quote: These positions are assigned by the student's department/program and are subject to the agreement between UMass Boston and UAW/Graduate Employees Organization (GEO). | Full Assistantship | 18.00 | 1.00 | $1,293.25 | $25,865.00 | 100%

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold at least a bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited institution or international equivalent to enter the 60-credit Chemistry PhD program.
entry_route.quote: At the time of enrollment, a bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited U.S. institution of recognized standing or an international equivalent.

also.quote: Applicants must meet general graduate admission requirements in addition to the following program-specific requirements: | Students are required to complete 60 credits of coursework, consisting of two core courses, three elective courses, a graduate seminar course and a dissertation research course.

notes: Offers five doctoral tracks: Biological Chemistry, Green Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, and Physical/Analytical Chemistry.
